AppConfig.title: Global App Config
AppConfig.description: Owner-controlled global time, appearance, unit, and announcement configuration synced in real time across signed-in user apps.

timeOffsetMinutes.description: Minutes shift applied to live Google time when timeMode is OFFSET (-1440..1440).

fixedTargetEpochMillis.description: Owner-specified target epoch milliseconds when timeMode is FIXED.

fixedAnchorEpochMillis.description: Google/network epoch milliseconds captured when the fixed owner time was published.

syncOverrideEnabled.description: Whether owner remote configuration overrides are currently active for all users.

primaryClockZone.description: Optional global primary clock timezone override.

weatherWindUnit.description: Optional global wind speed unit override.

bannerEnabled.description: Whether an owner broadcast banner is shown on the dashboard.

bannerMessage.description: Broadcast announcement text shown on user dashboards when bannerEnabled is true.

updatedByEmail.description: Verified owner email that last saved this configuration.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when config was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest owner update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/app_config/{configId}.description: Global application configuration document ('global') readable by authenticated users and writable exclusively by verified owner rajridam92@gmail.com.
